description: Meitnerium is a synthetic chemical element with symbol Mt and atomic number 109. It is an extremely radioactive synthetic element not found in nature but created in laboratories. It is a d-block transactinide element in the 7th period and group 9 of the periodic table.
characteristics: The most stable known isotope, meitnerium-278, has a half-life of 4.5 seconds. It is expected to be a solid metal with a face-centered cubic crystal structure and a density of around 27-28 g/cm³, making it one of the heaviest known elements. Meitnerium is calculated to be paramagnetic and to have properties similar to its lighter homologues cobalt, rhodium, and iridium.
